questions.finding: FastSpeech2: Bucketize always reshapes the pitch/energy target before TensorSearchSorted reads it, so the read lands on a traced Reshape.
questions.proposed_fix: values.Rank == 1 ? values : Engine.Reshape(values, ...) before TensorSearchSorted. Verified locally: FastSpeech2 passes; ProDiff 3->1 and AdaSpeech2 2->1 failures; no regressions. Patch in our scratchpad, not committed.
questions.alternatives: Traced bucketize: rejected, the embedding input check then host-reads traced indices and ProDiff/AdaSpeech2 regress.

questions.finding: SeedTTS TokenizerPretraining and Spark BiCodecAdversarialTraining/ValidAlternativeBands: CodecWaveformGan.Detached copies values on the host; IndexTtsPerceiver.Forward uses scalar TensorMax(norm, 1e-12) eagerly.
questions.proposed_fix: Detached(x) => Engine.StopGradient(x); TensorMax(norm, eps) -> relu(norm - eps) + eps.
questions.alternatives: None better; both are exact rewrites.

questions.finding: CosyVoice and CosyVoice2 VocoderStage: Harmonics/HarmonicsByFrames read f0 per sample on the host.
questions.proposed_fix: Express with engine ops (cumsum of f0*h/sr, then sin) so the plan replays it.
questions.alternatives: A CompiledStepHostValue node, if exact phase accumulation must stay in double.

questions.finding: CosyVoiceOptimizerOptions CoupledDecay (v1, clone): MatchaDecoder blocks use GroupNormalizationLayer and Engine.GroupNorm computes eagerly under a training trace.
questions.proposed_fix: Upstream: record GroupNorm lazily in training traces.
questions.alternatives: Interim: compose the norm from reductions in MatchaDecoder (as CosyVoiceModules.SingleGroupNorm does).

questions.finding: TransformerTTS (and likely Tacotron2, NonAttentiveTacotron): BatchNorm on non-float or non-rank-4 input computes immediately, reading the probe placeholder, so the probe aborts with "reads 'Reshape'". Trigger: ConvBatchNormStackLayer, rank-2 double.
questions.proposed_fix: When scope.IsProbe, record the BatchNorm node with correctly shaped outputs instead of computing.
questions.alternatives: None in AiDotNet without weakening the guard.
